description:
FILES: dispatcher.ex, runtime_state.ex (if applicable).

Add two more ETS tables alongside the handler dispatch table (same ownership model as opi-fin.3.1):

TOOLS TABLE:
- Type: :set
- Row format: {tool_name :: String.t(), tool_def :: map()}
- Use: Dispatcher.get_tool_definition/2 reads from this table instead of scanning Extension.t() list
- Population: after load_all/1, insert one row per tool across all extensions (first-wins for duplicates, matching current Dispatcher.get_tool_definition/2 semantics)

FLAGS TABLE:
- Type: :set
- Row format: {flag_name :: String.t(), value :: term()}
- Use: flag value reads go through this table
- Population: initialized from Extension.t() flags at load time; updated when set_flag is called

Both tables follow the same ownership rules as the handler table (opi-fin.3.1). Implement this ticket after opi-fin.3.1 establishes the ownership pattern.

Requires: opi-fin.3.1 merged first.
title: ETS active tools and flags tables
